findings.title: Items 37 and 38 unfinished; uncommitted WIP fails the hermetic bar and lint gate
findings.detail: 31 uncommitted paths (20 modified, 11 untracked; item 37 assistant backend). On the tree: pytest 2626 passed, 1 failed (test_every_entrypoint_exists_and_matches_the_shared_constant: extract_text.sh not in SANDBOX_JOB_ENTRYPOINTS); ruff 8 errors, ruff format 2 files, mypy 11 errors (common/config.py, chat/hermes_api.py, chat/backend.py, runner/chat_jobs.py, api/chat.py). Missing plan tests: test_backend, test_relay_gate, test_media, test_turns, unit and root test_extract_text, fake_hermes extension. dockerfilter/rules.py and sandbox-full Dockerfile changes need the record_corpus re-record and an images rebuild with the new digest. Item 38 (selftest, live model switch, sourced answer, github.io/gist, food photo, FINAL_REPORT.md) not started. Working rule 4: no approval while the tree is dirty. Fix: finish item 37 with its tests, lint-clean, commit; redeploy twice; run item 38 and close out.

findings.title: request_sandbox_job missing from the Hermes ossbot plugin
findings.detail: Plan item 35 and DESIGN 15.5/15.6 route all Hermes code execution through an ossbot plugin request for a research or agent-llm sandbox job scheduled by the gatekeeper. tools.py (HEAD and WIP) has status, queue, contribution, logs, request_discovery, notify, pause, kill and feature_* only; no tool, route or test exists. With terminal/code_execution off in every tier Hermes has no code-running path. Fix: add the tool and its gatekeeper route with role/tier checks, plus tests.

findings.title: Vendored fork not declared as a non-editable uv path dependency, deviation unrecorded
findings.detail: Item 34 requires a non-editable uv path dependency (uv lock, sync DEV/ROOTDEV). pyproject.toml changed only ruff/mypy config and uv.lock is untouched; tests add vendor/ to sys.path and the probe loads v3_core.py by path. Loading by path may be the better design (single import origin for the root probe), but nothing records it. Fix: add the dependency, or record the decision in the ADR-0002 addendum and the FEAT findings.

findings.title: Owner name and email hard-coded in a tracked script
findings.detail: scripts/dev/kiro-provider-bundle.sh (da6935a) sets the owner's name and email for the upstream commit and Signed-off-by. Hard rule 8 allows personal values in tracked files only under docs/ and in the gitignored config/profile.yaml. Fix: read them from git var GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT or the profile and refuse when unset.

findings.title: Upstream contribution bundle carries ossbot-specific defaults
findings.detail: The bundle copies kiro_acp/v3_core.py as is, with DEFAULT_KIRO_CLI under /home/hermes, DEFAULT_PROXY http://10.212.0.2:3141, EXPECTED_MODE ossbot-chat and references to ossbot DESIGN. Upstream users would inherit ossbot's network and mode. Fix: generic or env-driven defaults, with ossbot's values set in ossbot-hermes.service and the probe.
